highlights.title: First-party server-side tagging detected on 1 endpoint
highlights.detail: First-party hosts (ssl.o.webmd.com) carried Adobe Web SDK (First-Party Edge).

highlights.title: Contacted 79 third-party domains across 60 corporate groups
